rationale: The advisory Linux and Windows software-GPU proof lane must select the hosted software implementation that the runner exposes: lavapipe through Vulkan on Linux and WARP through D3D12 on Windows. Dawn's forceFallbackAdapter hint can request an unavailable SwiftShader path, so this change adds explicit Vulkan/D3D12 backend preferences, enumerates CPU adapters for the native Dawn path, and keeps normal fallback-adapter requests unchanged. The preference is used only by the opt-in PULP_GPU_SOFTWARE_ADAPTER proof recipe; generic hardware selection and presentation remain unchanged. It lands in Pulp because the proof lane and its adapter-selection integration are Pulp-owned, with no transferred Vellum framework implementation to backport.
